title: Mute CoPilot
desc: Whether you want CoPilot to speak to you or not. Try not to hurt its feelings.

title: Announcement Delay (Global)
desc: Set this if you want to delay the voice announcement, (0-15 seconds). Useful if you have other tools that might want to announce first. Note: will delay EVERY announcement.

title: Starting Situation
desc: Whether to provide a situation report when first starting up

title: Exit To Main Menu Announcements
desc: Whether to comment when you exit to the Main Menu in game

title: Route Announcements
desc: Whether to tell you route information when setting or changing course

title: System Targeting
desc: Whether to confirm the system name targeted when selecting on the Galaxy Map or Nav Panel

title: Jump Announcements
desc: Whether to tell you which system you are jumping to

title: Scoop Information
desc: Whether to tell you which stars are scoopable in your remaining route

title: Announce remaining scoopable jumps every X jumps
desc: If in a long chain of scoopables, you can choose to be told how many remaining in the chain every x jumps

title: Announce Target System Reached
desc: Whether to tell you when you have reached your target system

title: When to announce jumps
desc: If Jump Announcements is ON, when to trigger the announcement

title: Announce remaining jumps every X jumps
desc: Set this for frequency of announcement of remaining jumps in your toute

title: Last Here Announcements
desc: When you reach a target system, whether to tell you info on your previous visits

title: Compromised Nav Beacons
desc: Whether to tell you when a Compromised Nav Beacon is detected in the system

title: High Grade Emissions
desc: Whether to tell you if the system you have just jumped to is a HGE candidate

title: Announce Places Of Interest if system last visited was > x days ago
desc: Will announce Places of Interest when you jump into a system if you have last visited the system > x days ago. Set this to 0 to always announce POIs

title: Announce Thargoid controlled systems
desc: Warn you if you jump into a Thargoid occupied system

title: Announce Wanted status
desc: Warn you if you are Wanted in this system

title: Announce Warrant status
desc: Warn you if you have a warrant in this system

title: Announce Illegal Cargo
desc: Warn you if your cargo includes illegal items for this system

title: Announce Hostile status
desc: Warn you if you are regarded as Hostile in this system

title: Pirate Scans
desc: Whether to warn you when a pirate scan is detected

title: Pirate Interdictions
desc: Whether to warn you when a pirate interdiction is imminent

title: Targetting Announcements
desc: Whether to tell you details of the ship you are targetting

title: Announce Clean Ships
desc: If Targetting Announcements are on, whether to announce scans of clean ships

title: Station Facts
desc: Whether to tell you when station facts are available

title: Landing Pad Announcements
desc: Tell you your assigned landing pad. Will give you directions to the pad if at a starport and you have no docking computer installed.

title: Give landing pad directions even when a Docking Computer is installed
desc: Will give starport pad directions even though you have a Docking Computer.

title: Autodocking announcements
desc: Will comment when you request docking if you have a docking computer installed

title: Landing Pad Directions Delay
desc: If Landing Pad Directions is ON, then how long to delay until the landing pad directions are spoken (0-15 seconds)

title: Material Traders
desc: Whether to tell you there is a Material Trader when you dock at a station

title: Material Levels
desc: If Material Traders annoucnement setting is ON, Whether to report on your material levels if there is a material trader when you dock at a station

title: Announce outstanding cargo after mission acceptance
desc: Will give you a summary of all the cargo you need after accepting a cargo mission

title: Touchdown announcements
desc: Whether to announce touchdown on a body, and the number of landings on the body.

title: FSS scans: Terraformable announcements
desc: Whether to tell you when a scanned body is terraformable. Note, will only announce for new discoveries unless the 'already discovered' option is ON.

title: FSS scans: Atmospheric announcements. Note, will only announce for new discoveries unless the 'already discovered' option is ON.
desc: Whether to tell you when a scanned body has an atmosphere

title: FSS scans: Announce significant body characteristics even if already discovered
desc: If ON, EDCoPilot will tell you about signifant bodies you scan (ELW, terraformable, landable, atmo) even if already discovered

title: Announce Signals (geo, bio, human)
desc: If OFF, will not announce when you detect these signals

title: Announce Geological Signals
desc: If  Announce Signals is ON, and this is OFF, will not announce Geological signals when detected

title: Announce Human Signals
desc: If  Announce Signals is ON, and this is OFF, will not announce Human signals when detected

title: Asteroid Core Announcements
desc: Whether to tell you if a prospected asteroid contains cores

title: Asteroid Non-Core Announcements
desc: Whether to tell you if a prospected asteroid contains minerals of interest (those marked in your Management tab -> Prospector Announcements panel)

title: Minimal Mineral Interest Level
desc: Set this to the minimal percentage composition you want to be informed of.  Set which minerals you want it to announce this for on your Management Tab -> Prospector Announcements panel

title: Kill Announcements (in Ship or SRV)
desc: Whether to comment on your latest kill

title: Kill Announcements (On Foot)
desc: Whether to comment on a kill when you are on foot

title: Read Pirate Warnings
desc: Whether to read any pirate warnings that are detected

title: Time Trial waypoint passed announcement
desc: Tells you if you passed completely through a waypoint during a Time Trial. Useful when testing your own tracks

title: Low Fuel warning levels
desc: Set a list of fuel levels that EDCoPilot will warn once you cross, comma seperated ... eg 2,5,10,15

title: Synthesis completion
desc: Announce when a synthesis process (to repair or rearm) has completed

title: GalNet Announcements
desc: Tell you if there are new articles since your last session

title: Friend Online Announcement
desc: Whether to tell you when a friend goes online

title: Friend Offline Announcement
desc: Whether to tell you when a friend goes offline

title: Odyssey materials - Warning beep if collected material is irrelevant
desc: If ON, will give you an audible alert that you have picked up something that is irrelevant for suit or weapon progression

title: Odyssey materials - INFO message on Voice Log (not spoken) if collected material is irrelevant
desc: If ON, display on the last spoken bar and voice log the material you have just collected that is irrelevant for suit or weapon progression

title: Announce player emotes
desc: Whether to announce player emotes received in the game (eg. 'pointed at')

title: Warn if not latest version of Voice Attack Profile (VAP)
desc: Warn you if you dont have the latest profile active (Turn this OFF if you dont have VoiceAttack)

title: Announce keybind changes and backups
desc: If ON will tell you when changes detected and backed up, if OFF will only print as INFO to the VoiceLog

title: Verbally notify about keybind issues
desc: If ON will verbally warn you when there are issues with keybinds (usually on startup). If OFF, will only print warning messages in the Voice Log

title: Hide missing keybind warnings for non-Course Plotting contols
desc: If ON will not issue warnings for keybinds needed for the Controls panels

title: Announce GUI disconnection messages
desc: If ON will warn you when the GUI disconnects. This could be either the GUI has crashed, or took too long to respond to the main process

title: Plotting Debug Assistance
desc: Will walk you slowly through the steps required to plot course, to help you spot issues
